title: 第二卷2平康迷雾第二卷3剑仙困
content_zh:
;;
同一时刻，平康坊，莺歌楼。
平康坊是长安著名的“风流之地。”三条曲巷中遍布青楼楚馆、歌台舞榭。其中莺歌楼最为奢华，楼高三层，雕梁画栋，夜夜笙歌不绝。
三楼雅间“听雪轩”内，江流云和沈轻烟正与一位意想不到的人对坐。
那人是个女子，约莫三十许岁，穿着素雅的月白襦裙，发髻简单，只插一支银簪。她容貌算不得绝色，但气质沉静如水，尤其一双眼睛，澄澈得仿佛能映出人心。
她是莺歌楼的主人，也是长安地下情报网的掌控者之一——柳如是。
“李太白三日前确实来过。”柳如是斟茶，动作优雅，“他托我传一句话给吴王：剑图三分，意在诱敌。九幽阁所求非图，乃图中所藏‘金星魄’。”
“金星魄？”沈轻烟皱眉。
“太白金星坠落人间时残留的星核碎片。”柳如是解释，“据说蕴含至刚至锐的金灵本源。李太白将三份金星魄分别藏于三卷剑图中，九幽阁集齐三魄，便可强行唤醒金灵转世——或者更准确说，是制造一个受他们控制的金灵傀儡。”
江流云心中一动：“所以他们才大张旗鼓？真正的目标不是剑图本身，而是里面的金星魄？”
“正是。”柳如是点头，“而且据我所知，九幽阁已经找到了‘合适’的容器——一个身具金灵血脉却尚未觉醒的少年。只要三魄入体，他们就能制造出完全听命于阁主的金灵使者。”
沈轻烟追问：“那少年在何处？”
柳如是沉默片刻，轻轻吐出三个字：“兴庆宫。”
江流云和沈轻烟同时色变。
兴庆宫，那是玄宗皇帝与杨贵妃的居所！
“怎么可能……”江流云难以置信。
“那少年姓杨，名玉环之侄，名唤杨暄。”柳如是声音压得更低，“今年刚满十五，因貌美聪慧，被贵妃召入宫中陪伴。九幽阁不知用了什么手段，说动李相（李林甫）向皇上进言，称杨暄有‘宿慧’，宜入道观修行。三日后，皇上将下旨送杨暄入太真观——那观中主持，正是九幽阁的人。”
沈轻烟迅速理清线索：“所以九幽阁的计划是：先取三份金星魄，再借皇帝之口将杨暄送入太真观，在观中完成金灵觉醒仪式。届时，一个受他们控制的金灵使者就诞生了。”
“而李太白将计就计，以假剑图为饵，真身则在祁连山设局，想一举重创九幽阁主力。”江流云接话，“但这样一来，杨思纯他们拿到的假剑气篇……”
“是诱饵中的诱饵。”柳如是叹息，“李太白算准九幽阁会在雁塔设伏，但他没想到吴王殿下会请你们来。此刻雁塔那边，恐怕已经……”

话音未落，窗外突然传来急促的钟声。
宵禁钟！
紧接着，平康坊街道上传来整齐的脚步声和甲胄碰撞声——是金吾卫！
接着就听到门口传来的喧闹声，“好快，直接冲我们而来的”柳如是脸色微变，“九幽阁动用了朝廷力量。他们想趁宵禁将你们一网打尽。为免打草惊蛇，不宜动用法力．．”
她迅速起身，推开雅间暗门：“跟我来”，她用力掀起地板，下方露出密道，她拿起桌上的灯盏，待几人走下地道把地板盖回。几人往前走了一段，停下脚步，密道尽头是一间暗室。暗室中堆满了卷宗，墙上挂着一幅巨大的长安地图，地图上密密麻麻标注着各种符号。
“这是九幽阁在长安的所有据点、人员名单、以及与朝中官员的往来记录。”柳如是取下一枚玉简，“你们带给李太白。另外……”
她犹豫了一下，还是说了出来：“告诉太白先生，当年他救下的那个小女孩，如今已经能独当一面了。还有……我从未怨过他。”
沈轻烟深深看了她一眼，接过玉简：“我们会带到。”
密道出口在安兴坊一处废弃宅院。三人钻出时，坊外街道上已满是金吾卫的火把光亮。
“往西走，延平门守卫中有我的人，这是令牌。”柳如是塞给江流云一枚铜牌，“出城后一路向西，陇右道有接应。”
“多谢。”江流云郑重拱手。
柳如是摇头：“快走吧。记住，九幽阁的势力远超你们想象。他们阁主幽冥子……很可能不是人。”
不是人？江流云还欲再问，柳如是已退回密道，暗门关闭的一刹那，江丢出一个小布包入门，他沉声道：柳姑娘尽快吸收此灵石精华，我等期盼姑娘相聚。暗门关闭。
街道上传来兵士的呼喝声。
沈轻烟拉住江流云：“走！”
二人施展轻功，在坊墙屋脊间飞掠。夜空下，长安城宛如一个巨大的棋盘，而他们只是棋盘上两颗微不足道的棋子。
但棋子，有时也能改变棋局。
---
同一时刻，大雁塔顶。
金色剑气牢笼中，杨思纯尝试了各种方法都无法突破。这剑气似乎专门克制水系灵力，他的水剑触之即溃。

阴九龄悬浮在半空，好整以暇地看着他们：“不必白费力气了。这是李太白亲自布下的‘太白剑牢’，除非金灵之力，否则绝难破解。”
他顿了顿，又道：“不过二位放心，阁主只想要你们体内的灵力，不会伤及性命。待抽取完毕，自会放你们离去。”

At the same moment, Pingkangfang and Yingge Tower.
Pingkangfang is a famous "romantic place" in Chang'an. The three winding alleys are dotted with brothels, Chu pavilions, song stages and dance pavilions. Among them, Yingge Tower is the most luxurious, with a three-story building, carved beams and painted buildings, and endless music and music every night.
In the elegant room "Tingxue Xuan" on the third floor, Jiang Liuyun and Shen Qingyan were sitting across from an unexpected person.
The person was a woman, about thirty years old, wearing a simple and elegant moon-white skirt, with a simple bun with only a silver hairpin inserted. Her appearance is not stunning, but her temperament is as calm as water, especially her eyes, which are so clear that they seem to reflect the human heart.
She is the owner of Yingge Tower and one of the controllers of the Chang'an underground intelligence network - Liu Rushi.
"Li Taibai did come here three days ago." Liu Rushi poured tea with graceful movements, "He asked me to pass a message to King Wu: The sword picture is divided into three parts, which is intended to lure the enemy. What Jiuyou Pavilion seeks is not a picture, but the 'Venus Soul' hidden in the picture."
"Venus Soul?" Shen Qingyan frowned.
"The star core fragments left behind when Taibai Venus fell to the human world." Liu Rushi explained, "It is said to contain the most powerful and sharp origin of the Golden Spirit. Li Taibai hid three Venus souls in three volumes of sword pictures. By gathering the three souls in Jiuyou Pavilion, they can forcibly awaken the reincarnation of the Golden Spirit - or to be more precise, create a Golden Spirit puppet controlled by them."
Jiang Liuyun's heart moved: "Is that why they are making such a big show? The real target is not the sword diagram itself, but the Venus Soul inside?"
"Exactly." Liu Rushi nodded, "And as far as I know, Jiuyou Pavilion has found a 'suitable' container - a young man with the blood of the Golden Spirit who has not yet awakened. As long as the three souls enter the body, they can create a Golden Spirit envoy who is completely obedient to the Pavilion Master's orders."
Shen Qingyan asked: "Where is that young man?"
Liu Rushi was silent for a moment, then softly uttered three words: "Xingqing Palace."
Jiang Liuyun and Shen Qingyan's expressions changed at the same time.
Xingqing Palace is the residence of Emperor Xuanzong and Concubine Yang!
"How is it possible..." Jiang Liuyun couldn't believe it.
"The young man's surname is Yang, his nephew is Yuhuan, and his name is Yang Xuan." Liu Rushi lowered his voice, "He just turned fifteen this year. Because of his beauty and intelligence, he was summoned by the imperial concubine to accompany him in the palace. I don't know what tricks Jiuyou Pavilion used. , persuaded Prime Minister Li (Li Linfu) to advise the emperor that Yang Xuan had "Suhui" and should enter the Taoist temple to practice. Three days later, the emperor ordered that Yang Xuan be sent to Taizhen Temple - the person who presided over the temple was none other than Jiuyou Pavilion."
Shen Qingyan quickly sorted out the clues: "So Jiuyou Pavilion's plan is to first take three copies of the Golden Star Soul, and then use the emperor's mouth to send Yang Xuan to Taizhen Temple, where he will complete the Golden Spirit Awakening Ceremony. By then, a Golden Spirit Messenger under their control will be born."
"And Li Taibai used the fake sword picture as bait, and his real body set up a trap in Qilian Mountain, hoping to defeat the main force of Jiuyou Pavilion in one fell swoop." Jiang Liuyun continued, "But in this way, the fake sword energy chapter that Yang Sichun and the others obtained..."
"It's the bait among the baits." Liu Rushi sighed, "Li Taibai was sure that Jiuyou Pavilion would set up an ambush at the Wild Goose Pagoda, but he didn't expect that His Highness King Wu would invite you. At this moment, I'm afraid there is already..."
Before he finished speaking, a rapid bell suddenly sounded outside the window.
Curfew clock!
Immediately afterwards, the sound of neat footsteps and the clash of armors came from the streets of Pingkangfang - it was Jinwu Guard!
Then I heard the noise coming from the door, "So fast, they are coming directly towards us." Liu Rushi's face changed slightly, "Jiuyou Pavilion has used the power of the imperial court. They want to take advantage of the curfew to catch you all. In order to avoid alerting the snake, it is not appropriate to use magic..."
She stood up quickly and pushed open the secret door of the private room: "Follow me." She lifted up the floor with force, revealing a secret passage underneath. She picked up the lamp on the table and covered the floor back after several people walked down the tunnel. Several people walked forward for a while and stopped. At the end of the secret passage was a dark room. The darkroom is filled with files, and a huge map of Chang'an hangs on the wall, with various symbols densely marked on the map.
"This is all the Jiuyou Pavilion’s strongholds in Chang’an, the list of personnel, and the records of interactions with officials from the DPRK and China. Liu Rushi took off a jade slip and said, "Bring it to Li Taibai." In addition..."
She hesitated for a moment, but finally said it: "Tell Mr. Taibai that the little girl he saved back then is now able to stand alone. And...I never blamed him. "
Shen Qingyan looked at her deeply and took the jade slip: "We will bring it to you. "
The exit of the secret passage is in an abandoned house in Anxingfang. When the three of them got out, the streets outside the square were already filled with the light of Jin Wuwei's torches.
"Go west, there are my men among the guards at Yanping Gate, this is the token. "Liu Rushi handed Jiang Liuyun a bronze medal and said, "After leaving the city, head west, and there will be support from Longyou Road. "
"Thank you. "Jiang Liuyun solemnly handed over his hand.
Liu Rushi shook his head: "Let's go. Remember, the power of Jiuyou Pavilion is far beyond your imagination. Their pavilion master You Mingzi... is probably not a human being. "
Not a human? Jiang Liuyun wanted to ask again, but Liu Rushi had retreated to the secret passage. The moment the secret door was closed, Jiang threw out a small cloth bag and said in a deep voice: Miss Liu will absorb the essence of this spirit stone as soon as possible. We look forward to meeting you. The secret door is closed.
The shouts of soldiers came from the streets.
Shen Qingyan pulled Jiang Liuyun: "Let's go! "
The two used light skills to fly between the ridges of the walls and roofs of the square. Under the night sky, Chang'an City looked like a huge chessboard, and they were just two insignificant pieces on the chessboard.
But chess pieces can sometimes change the game.
---
At the same moment, the top of the Big Wild Goose Pagoda.
In the golden sword energy cage, Yang Sichun tried various methods but could not break through. This sword energy seems to be specially designed to restrain water spiritual power, and his water sword collapses upon contact.
Yin Jiuling was suspended in the air and looked at them leisurely: "No need to waste your efforts. This is the 'Taibai Sword Prison' set up by Li Taibai himself. It will be extremely difficult to break unless the power of the golden spirit is used. "
He paused and then said: "But don't worry, the master only wants the spiritual power in your body and will not harm your life. After the extraction is completed, I will let you go. "
